counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动生成历史科学科普短视频的全套素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速产出历史科学类科普短视频的文案和分镜
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate full materials for historical science short videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce scripts and storyboards for historical science short videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可根据你提供的主题、年代、核心结论，自动生成历史科学类3分钟科普短视频的素材包，包含口播文案、分镜脚本、Veo2提示词和人物形象规范，保存到指定文件夹。
howto.when: 当你要做历史科学类科普视频、需要完整素材包，并提供主题、年代和核心结论时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一期‘青霉素的发现’1928年的科普短视频素材包
say.note: 将自动生成口播文案、分镜、Veo2提示词等。

say.text: 把‘蝴蝶效应的起源’做成3分钟科普视频，给全套素材
say.note: 需补充核心科学结论，如初始条件敏感性。

say.text: 生成‘相对论’1905年的视频素材，核心结论是时空弯曲
say.note: 输出脚本、分镜、提示词到指定目录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a complete material pack for 3-minute historical-science short videos based on your topic, era, and core conclusion, including narration script, storyboard, Veo2 prompts, and character design, saved to a target folder.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need to make a historical-science popular video and provide the topic, era background, and core scientific conclusion.

say_en.text: Make a material pack for a short video on 'Discovery of Penicillin' in 1928.
Create a 3-minute science video pack about 'Origin of Butterfly Effect'.
say_en.note: Add core conclusion like sensitivity to initial conditions.

say_en.text: Generate 1905 'Relativity' video materials with conclusion of spacetime curvature.
say_en.note: Outputs scripts, storyboard, prompts to the folder.
